title: Measurement comparability
responsibility: Determines whether a measurement and baseline describe the same quantity and sampling method before their numeric values are compared.

inputs.name: comparisonDifferences.metric
inputs.description: Metric name used to enforce the expected unit for known latency, throughput and memory metrics; custom metrics require matching units.

inputs.name: comparisonDifferences.measured
inputs.description: Current measurement’s unit, method description and comparison context; missing or invalid metadata is reported as incomplete.

inputs.name: comparisonDifferences.baseline
inputs.description: Reviewed baseline’s unit, method description and comparison context.

outputs.name: comparisonDifferences
outputs.description: Comparable with no differences when definitions match; incomplete when metadata is missing or invalid; otherwise incompatible with ordered differences for unit, request, boundary, protocol, sampling and method.
